reason: The cited evidence does not directly test or support the key premises about multilayer interfaces blocking dislocations to reduce creep. E1 studies a monolithic HEA coating, E2 discusses creep mechanisms in bulk HEAs without multilayers, and E4 shows crack arrest at a graphene interface in a different system, not coherent HEA multilayers. The specific claims about creep rate reduction and interface dislocation blocking lack prior experimental backing.
premises: Coherent multilayer interfaces block dislocation glide and climb
Blocking dislocations increases activation energy for creep
Multilayer coatings will show 20-30% lower creep strain rate vs monolithic
Dislocation accumulation will be observed at interfaces post-deformation
Optimal layer thickness is <100 nm for interface effectiveness
